title: F16 WMMA support for native HIP GEMM
description: Add F16 dtype support using __builtin_amdgcn_wmma_f32_16x16x16_f16_w32 intrinsic. Template the kernel on element type (bf16 vs f16) and corresponding WMMA intrinsic. Coverage: 16 -> 17 shapes (unlocks small_f16).
close_reason: F16 WMMA support via WmmaTraits template. 17/17 tests pass including small_f16 (~48 TFLOPS).

title: Benchmark all in-tree GEMM tests
description: Use the Codex sandbox workflow to benchmark all GEMM tests currently checked into gemm/tests across the existing kernel providers, starting with hipblaslt and iree, and record the resulting performance artifacts and notes.
notes: PR #2 opened for benchmark artifacts. Validation: hipblaslt and iree completed all 17 tests with --verify enabled for 10 reference-backed tests; native_hip produced results for 3 tests and failed 14 unsupported shape/type cases.
close_reason: Stale benchmark artifact PR #2 was closed without merge; no remaining work for now.

title: GEMM kernel boundary handling + K-padding
description: Add runtime boundary checks to the 128x128 WMMA kernel so it handles arbitrary M, N (not multiples of 128) and arbitrary K (not multiples of 32 or 16). Edge tiles load zeros for OOB, K-padding zero-fills partial WMMA tiles. Grid uses ceil_div. No templates — one kernel with runtime guards. Remove alignment asserts from bench.cpp and skip logic from run.py. Coverage: 3 -> 14 of 17 test shapes.

title: Skinny-M GEMM kernels (16x128, 32x128 tiles)
description: Add separate kernel functions for small-M shapes: gemm_wmma_16x128 (2 warps, 64 threads, 5 WGs/CU) and gemm_wmma_32x128 (4 warps, 128 threads, 5 WGs/CU). Each has its own warp layout, load pattern, and launch bounds. Boundary handling from bd-20c built in. Dispatch: M<=16 -> 16x128, M<=32 -> 32x128, else 128x128. Coverage: 14 -> 16 shapes.
close_reason: Skinny-M kernel (BM=128,BN=16) informed by hipblaslt profiling. 2.7-4x speedup on M<=32 shapes. 7-10% roofline efficiency.

title: Refactor native_hip: split kernels into separate files with shared header
description:
Split native_hip_gemm.hip into separate files per kernel, with shared __device__ utilities in a header.

Target layout:
- include/kernelgen_wmma_utils.h — shared __device__ helpers (load_128, zero_128, bf16x16/f32x8 types, tile constants, WMMA fragment layout)
- src/gemm_wmma_128x128.hip — aligned 128x128 kernel
- src/gemm_wmma_128x128_boundary.hip — boundary-aware 128x128 kernel
- src/native_hip_gemm.hip — host run() dispatch only (no kernel code)
- CMakeLists.txt — add new sources

Each kernel file includes the shared header. This sets up the codebase for adding more kernel variants (skinny-M tiles, F16, bandwidth-optimized) without a monolithic file.
close_reason: Split kernels into separate files with shared kernelgen_wmma_utils.h header. All 16 BF16 tests pass.

title: BLAS-like dispatch API for native HIP GEMM
description: Create a public C API (kernelgen_gemm.h) with kernelgen_gemm() and kernelgen_gemm_supported(). Stateless, no handle. Takes config struct (M,N,K,dtype,layout,alpha), device pointers, and HIP stream. Dispatch selects kernel by M-threshold, boundary handling is built in. Add --use-dispatch flag to bench.cpp.
close_reason: C dispatch API (kernelgen_gemm.h) with --use-dispatch benchmark flag. All 16 BF16 tests pass through dispatch path.

title: Optimize native HIP GEMM kernel performance
description: Profile the native HIP GEMM kernel, identify bottlenecks, and iteratively optimize to improve TFLOPS. Document what worked and what didn't.
close_reason: Optimization complete, report updated with corrected clock analysis

title: Add Fusilli GEMM provider
description: Inspect how existing GEMM kernel providers are wired into kernelGen, then add Fusilli as a new provider. Fusilli wraps IREE, but it should appear as its own kernel provider so we can benchmark Fusilli and IREE directly against each other on the same tests. Update provider registration, build wiring, runner integration, and docs as needed, and capture any setup assumptions or blockers.
close_reason: PR #1 merged; Fusilli GEMM provider work is complete.
